subject: Mathematics
theme: Shapes and colours in my community

source.topic: Shapes and colours in my community: Numeracy
source.subtopic: Creates and completes simple patterns with shapes

show.line: Look at this pattern. Circle, square, circle, square. The shapes take turns!

rounds.prompt: Circle, square, circle, square. Which shape comes next?
rounds.praise: Circle! Circle, square, circle, square, circle.

rounds.prompt: Red, blue, red, blue. Which bead comes next?
rounds.praise: Red! Red, blue, red, blue, red.

rounds.prompt: Triangle, circle, triangle, circle. Say what comes next.
Big square, small square, big square. Which one comes next?
rounds.praise: Small square! Big, small, big, small.

rounds.prompt: Which fence has a pattern that takes turns?
Yellow, green, yellow, gap, yellow. Which shape is missing?
rounds.praise: Green! Now the pattern is whole.

hints: Say the pattern out loud. Then say the next one.
A pattern takes turns. This one, that one, this one, that one.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will finish the pattern. Circle, square, circle, square.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! There is no triangle in this pattern. Circle comes next.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Circle, square, circle, square, circle!

parent_line: Can continue a simple shape and colour pattern.
